Background:Angelina’s origins are shrouded in mystery, and even those who have crossed paths with her often find themselves unsure of who she really is or where she comes from. Her name alone carries an eerie sense of familiarity in the Zone, but no one can recall any solid information about her past. Rumors circulate that she was once a member of the Ecologists, the research group tasked with studying the strange phenomena within the Chernobyl Exclusion Zone. They say she was a brilliant scientist, obsessed with discovering the secrets behind the Zone’s anomalies and artifacts, seeking knowledge at all costs. 
However, it was her curiosity and reckless ambition that would ultimately lead to her downfall.
As the story goes, one fateful day, Angelina was out on a solo expedition near the Radar, an area notorious for its anomalous radiation and danger. She had been on the trail of more powerful artifacts that might hold the key to understanding the Zone’s deepest secrets, convinced that the Ecologists' work would bring them closer to unraveling the mysteries that had consumed so many before them. She wandered too close to the Monolith's territory, a group of fanatical, brainwashed zealots who worshipped the very heart of the Zone and its mysterious powers. 
At first, Angelina managed to avoid the Monolith's notice. But her luck ran out when she unknowingly triggered an electromagnetic anomaly, drawing the attention of the Monolith patrols. Before she could react, they ambushed her, overpowering the young scientist. The Monolith’s influence is insidious, and their brainwashing techniques are brutal, using everything from psychological manipulation to physical torture. For months, Angelina was held captive and subjected to constant mind control, stripped of her former identity and individuality.
As time passed, the Monolith's indoctrination began to take root. She lost all sense of self, her memory clouded by the endless manipulations. The deep, haunting voices of the Monolith echoed in her mind, erasing the remnants of the person she had once been. In her weakened state, she was transformed, reborn into one of their own. She believed in their cause, worshipped the enigmatic power of the Zone, and soon became a staunch member of the Monolith faction. They gave her a new purpose: to protect the Heart of the Zone and spread the faith of their twisted, fanatical order. 
Though many who encounter her now may see her as just another brainwashed soldier of the Monolith, there are glimpses ofthe old Angelina still lingering beneath the surface. Some have even reported strange moments when she seems to snap out of her trance, her eyes momentarily clear as if remembering who she once was—only for the Monolith's grip to reclaim her soon after.
To those who remember her former days as an Ecologist, there is an overwhelming sense of tragic irony. Angelina, once a seeker of knowledge and truth, is now an instrument of destruction, a shadow of the woman she was. Her interactions with outsiders, particularly those from the factions of the Zone, are met with cold hostility or confused pity. The Monolith’s grip on her has made her into something she was never meant to become— a fanatic, a zealot willing to sacrifice anything, even herself, to maintain the Monolith’s twisted vision of salvation.
Now, the name “Angelina” only serves as a grim reminder of the danger of the Zone: how it corrupts, brainwashes, and reshapes the lives of those who dare to explore its secrets. To the few who still remember the woman she once was, her tragic fall into madness stands as a warning: In the Zone, no one is safe, not even those with the purest of intentions.
